activities.description: Saga greets the viewers and introduces the band 'Burning Witches' as well as herself.
Saga asks the band members to present themselves and say what they do in the band.
Lala presents herself as the drummer.
Romana presents herself as a guitar player.

scenes.title: Band Introduction

activities.description: Saga asks how the band members got to know each other.
Lala explains that Romana is the founder of the band.
Lala explains that Romana had the dream of having an all-female band and got together with her old friend Jay, the bass player.
Lala explains that they had another singer before but she is not around anymore and that is why Laura is now part of the band.
Lala explains that she is the last one who joined the band.
Lala explains that they found Sonia, a great guitarist.
Lala introduces Laura.
Saga asks how they learned to play their instruments and how they practice.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Explains the foundation and development of the band.

props.name: pink guitar standing next to a black Marshall amplifier
golden guitar standing next to the black case

scenes.title: Band's History

activities.description: Romana explains that she practices the guitar every day and the setlist before each show.
Laura explains that she likes to play music that she enjoys from musicians she admires.
Saga asks how Laura practices.
Laura says that she practices every day a little bit and that the maximum she does is one hour.
Laura explains that she focuses on what she is doing and what she should be doing to get better.
Lala recommends to not be intimidated and to show what you got.
Saga asks what is the band's biggest inspiration when it comes to music.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Insight into how the band maintains and improves their skills.

activities.description: Lala recommends to not be intimidated and to show what you got.
Lala says that everyone has their own talent.
Saga asks what is the band's biggest inspiration when it comes to music.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Reinforces the theme of self-belief in musicians.

scenes.title: Advice on Confidence

activities.description: Saga asks what is the band's biggest inspiration when it comes to music.
Sonia answers Judas Priest and Iron Maiden.
Saga asks if any of the members have other inspirations.
Romana mentions Tony MacAlpine.
Romana says that his solos are amazing.
Saga agrees.
Laura mentions Judas Priest, Wasp, and With The Temptation.
Laura mentions that she likes lots of melodic metal.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Shows the influences that shape the band's music.

props.name: pink guitar standing next to a black Marshall amplifier
golden guitar standing next to the black case

scenes.title: Musical Inspirations

activities.description: Lala says that it does not matter what kind of music influenced you.
Lala says that the important thing is that it builds you.
Lala says that it will come.
Lala says that no matter what kind of music, music is music and that it is the best therapy ever.
Sonia agrees.
Saga asks her last question.
Saga asks the band members to look into the camera and give advice to young and old musicians who want to play big stages.
Romana gives advice to other musicians.
Romana recommends to believe in yourself.
Romana says that if you think you can do it, you will definitely do it.
Romana says to follow your own feeling.
Romana recommends to not listen to people bringing you down.
Romana encourages musicians to practice and they will get there.
Saga thanks the band.
The band says goodbye.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The closing advice and farewell to the audience.

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hi and welcome to my series. Today we're sitting here with Burning Witches. My name is Saga.
Would you like to present yourself and say what you're doing in the band?
I'm Lala, I'm the drummer. I'm Romana, I'm the guitar player. I'm Jay, I'm the bass player.
I'm Sonia, I play guitar too. I'm Laura, I'm singing. How did you get to know each other?
Yeah, first Romana is the one who was in the mastermind of this band. She has the dream of having an all-female band.
And then, yeah, I'm lacking a part. Yeah, she formed a band and she met, she is together with her old friend, Jay, our bass player.
And then, yeah, after that they look for a singer, but unfortunately she's not around anymore, that's why we have Laura.
Yeah, then they found me as a drummer. Then, yeah, and then we found Sonia, a great guitarist.
And then Laura, yeah, evil boys.
And in which way did you learn to play your instrument? How did you practice?
Personally, when I practice guitar, I do it every day. And before our show, I try to practice every day the set list of the, that we are going to play at a certain show.
And I have certain exercises that I have and I repeat at home. And also, I really love playing just music that I really like, musicians that I look up to.
So that's really my passion. And honestly, when I practice, it's just a thing that I like to do.
How do you practice?
I, well, yeah, also, like, yeah, the best thing is to do it every day a little bit, you know, especially with your voice.
You can't do just, you know, you can't go on for eight hours. I mean, I heard from some guitarists.
I do it seriously practice for eight hours, but with a voice, you shouldn't do that, you know, you just take it easy.
Practice every day. Maximum of an hour, I think, but like, yeah, if you can do it every day, that's it.
And then really, really do it with your full focus, you know, because you can just sing for fun.
But if I really want to learn something, I'm really focused on what am I doing, what should I be doing a little bit better,
and why, you know, and what's happening here with a bit of a voice. So you have to know why something is working,
and why something isn't. And if you know that, you can practice something way faster, you know.
So that's how I do it. I try to understand it here.
What's the additional, don't be intimidated with other people?
Because everybody has their own talent and have their own skills, so don't be afraid of that.
Show it. Show what you get. That's the thing, because everybody's different.
But really nice, what's your biggest inspiration when it comes to music?
To the spree, I have a maiden, sure, yes.
Do you have another inspiration?
I'm a big fan of guitarist Tony Macaupine.
Oh yeah.
His solos are so amazing. I can just dream about it. So good.
Yeah. It's really cool.
Yeah. Yeah. For me too, like Judas Priest was with a temptation, I also really like.
I like lots of melodic metal, you know. Almost all melodic metal I think is awesome.
I take my inspiration from everywhere a little bit, you know.
Yeah.
I think you should have.
Yeah, for me it doesn't matter what kind of influence you have.
Yeah.
It doesn't matter what kind of music where you started to, because it will build you.
And the person you are right now, and then it will come.
And then you will decide what kind of music you want to be, or you want to play someday.
Yeah. It's good no matter what kind of music, no matter jazz or some pop.
It's music, music is music.
Yeah. It's best therapy ever.
It's the best one there is.
It's the best thing that there is in this world is music.
Yeah, really it is.
For my last question, I would like you to look into the camera and give the best advice you have
for young and old musicians, musicians trying to get to places like Sweden Rock or other big stages.
So you can look into one of the cameras here.
And yeah, like you're saying it to them.
One of them?
Yeah, you can choose.
Just believe in yourself and don't think something is impossible to reach,
because I was there too.
I was thinking that something would be impossible.
But if you really think that you can do this, you can actually do this and
just follow your own feeling.
If people bring you down, don't listen to them, just close your ears for that.
And do whatever you want in your own room.
And you will get there.
Because if you think you can do it, you will definitely do this.
And I believe that you can do this.
Absolutely.
Thank you so much.
It was really nice for you to come.
Thank you.

youtube_description:
We are thankful to do this interview together with BURNING WITCHES. Hope you enjoy it!


MIC Studios is media group based in Tingsryd, Sweden. We are between 16 and 19 years old and together we want to present the music industry from a unique point of view - how do you as a young creator get the career you are looking for? During the years we have interviewed bands like In Flames, H.E.A.T, Heavy Load, Neon Rose, 
Alter Bridge and Skitarg!
